AppPlatformIngressLogs.operations_status: not enumerated in Azure docs (checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/spring-apps/basic-standard/diagnostic-services); columns below are the verified allowlist
AppPlatformIngressLogs.operations_note: Read the service's own 'Analyze Logs and Metrics in Azure Spring Apps' diagnostics page and the Azure Monitor supported-logs reference. IngressLogs are nginx access logs (columns like RemoteIP, Host, Request, Status, RequestTime, ReqId); the page enumerates KQL column names, not any fixed OperationName/ActionName value list. This is a telemetry/access-log table, not an audit (serviceName, actionName) pair table. No doc enumerates operation values.

AppPlatformLogsforSpring.operations_status: not enumerated in Azure docs (checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/spring-apps/basic-standard/diagnostic-services); columns below are the verified allowlist
AppPlatformLogsforSpring.operations_note: The diagnostics page (ApplicationConsole category) describes this as the console log of all customer applications; example queries project columns like TimeGenerated, ServiceName, AppName, InstanceName, Log. It is free-form application console output, not an audit action table, and no page enumerates OperationName/ActionName values. The supported-logs reference only lists columns.

AppPlatformSystemLogs.operations_note: SystemLogs has a LogType column whose documented values are ConfigServer, ServiceRegistry, ApiPortal, ApplicationConfigurationService, SpringCloudGateway, SpringCloudGatewayOperator, but those are LogType (component) values, not OperationName/ActionName operation values. Columns projected are TimeGenerated, LogType, Level, ServiceName, Thread, Stack, Log, _ResourceId. No doc enumerates operation/action values for this table.
